Differential comparison with Renovate

Offing and Renovate answer different questions, so only the places where both can speak about one dependency in one file are compared (see Differential testing against Renovate). Every disagreement below links to its evidence. The same data is in differential-report.json.

Repository Agree Offing-only Renovate-only Inconclusive
excalidraw/excalidraw 23 2 2 0
gethomepage/homepage 0 0 0 0
mealie-recipes/mealie 17 0 4 0
outline/outline 22 5 13 0
umami-software/umami 8 1 0 0
Total 70 8 19 0
